# Rule: Dispatched ISA variant dropped

_Canonical rule slug:_ `cpu-dispatch-isa-dropped`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A runtime-dispatched implementation drops an instruction-set variant, silently downgrading or failing on hardware that used it.
